_comment: Template for OBJECT_SINGLE: one object, sent once, for rt-mbs-application-provider.
Loaded twice, like every template here: once on the MBS User Services card for the 'service'
block, once on the Ingest Sessions card for the 'sessions' array. See templates/README.md.
Use this for a one-off delivery (a software image, a data file) where every intended receiver
is already listening. Nothing repeats, so a receiver that is not listening at the time gets
nothing; where that matters, use OBJECT_CAROUSEL instead, or FEC to survive residual loss.
_subscription: Optional. When present, loading this template on the Ingest Sessions card prefills the Status
Subscription form beneath it -- the notification URI, and the events ticked below. It does not
subscribe: that stays a deliberate, separate step, like creating the service and the session.
A subscription is per Ingest Session, so it cannot be prepared until the session exists, which
is why the form only appears once one has been created.
The events below are the ones that tell you whether delivery actually started, plus the two
failure events that explain a session that never does. Tick more in the form if you want the
full lifecycle; the running MBSF's own list is what the form offers, and an event named here
that it does not offer is reported rather than silently dropped.

_opMode: TS 26.517 V18.6.0 clause 6.2.3.2 defines OBJECT_SINGLE. Change to COLLECTION (clause
6.2.3.4) to send several related objects once as one set, listing them all in acqIds.
_fecConfig: Worth more here than in a repeating mode: with a single transmission there is no later
cycle to recover a lost block from. Remove for no FEC.
